Banki cyangwa ikindi kigo gitanga serivisi zo
kwishyurana byirengera ingaruka ku mukiriya
a) ku gihombo cyatewe n`ukutagenda neza k`
uburyo bwo kwoherereza koranabuhanga
kw`amafaranga cyangwa kw`ibikoresho
hagamijwe gukora ihererekanya ryakiriwe kandi
ryemewe n`icyuma koranabuhanga bijyanye
n`amabwiriza y`umukiriya; cyangwa
b) Habayeho amakosa mu kubara cyangwa mu
ibaruramari ryakozwe n`ikigo
Banki cyangwa ikindi kigo gitanga serivisi zo
kwishyurana bizamenyesha vuba umukiriya ku
hifashishijwe :
a) Imenyesha ku cyuma koranabuhanga cyo
kubikuza (ATM), POS, cyangwa ibindi byuma
koranabuhanga ;
b) Imenyesha ku mashami yayo; cyangwa
c) ubundi buryo bufatwa ko ari bwiza,
Igihe bizwi ko uburyo cyangwa ibikoresho
bikoreshwa mu kohererezanya koranabuhanga
kw`amafaranga bidafite ubushobozi bwo gukora
cyangwa bikora nabi.
Igihe umukiriya yagombye kuba azi ko uburyo
cyangwa ibikoresho bidafite ubushobozi bwo
gukora cyangwa bidakora neza, inshingano z‟ikigo
zigarukira ku gukosora amakosa muri konti
y`umukiriya nogusubiza ubwishyu bwose umukiliya
yatanze kugira ngo akorerwe kohereza amafaranga.
N`ubwo hari ibiteganywa mu gika (3) banki
cyangwa ibindi bigo bitanga serivisi zo kwishyurana
ntabwo bizirengera ingaruka ku mukiriya iyo
ukudashobora gukorera umukiliya ukohererezanya
koranabuhanga kw`amafaranga byatewe cyangwa
byaturutse k`ugushaka kw`Imana cyangwa izindi
mpamvu adafiteho ububasha, mu gihe cyose ikigo
cyakoranye ubushishozi n‟ubwitonzi buhagije.

articles.heading: Umutekano mu kubitsa ku bikoreshokoranabuhanga Umutekano w‟amafaranga abikijwe yakiriwe ku ku
articles.text:
byuma koranabuhanga ucungwa n`ikigo cyakira uko
kubitsa uhereye igihe kubitsa birangiriye,
hakagenzurwa umubare w`amafaranga yabikijwe.
Iyo habonetse ikinyuranyo hagati y `ayanditswe
nk`ayabikijwe mu buryo bw`icyuma koranabuhanga
n`ayanditswe nk`ayakiriwe, ikigo kigomba
kumenyesha umukiriya ikinyuranyo umunsi
ukurikira kandi cyikavuga amafaranga yashyizwe
kuri konti y`umukiriya

articles.heading: Inshingano zo kumenyesha amakosa Umukiriya agomba kumenyesha banki ye cyangwa ikindi kigo gitanga serivisi zo kwishyurana amakosa
articles.text:
ari mu imenyesha ry‟uko konti ihagaze cyangwa
ihererekanya ritatangiwe uruhushya rijyanye
n`ikarita ye cyangwa imibare y`ibanga mu kurinda.
Imenyesha rizakorwa mu nyandiko mu gihe
cy`iminsi 30 uhereye k`umunsi w‟imenyesha ry‟uko
konti ihagaze. Hakurikijwe ikigamijwe n`iyi
ngingo, umukiriya agomba :
a) Gutanga izina na nimero za konti;
b) Gusobanura impamvu yumva ko hari
amakosa, akavuga amafaranga yari ariho
n`itariki y`amakosa cyangwa uguhererekanya
koranabuhanga kw`amafaranga kutemewe ;
c) Asabwa kohereza ibisobanuro birambuye ku
makosa mu nyandiko mu minsi 10 y`akazi.
Igihe hari ikirego cy‟umukiliya ku uguhererezanya
koranabuhanga ry`amafaranga kutemewe, ni ikigo
gifite inshingano zo kugaragaza ibimenyetso by‟uko
iryo yohererezanya koranabuhanga ry`amafaranga
ryari rifitiwe uruhushya.
Inshingano zo kugaragaza ibimenyetso zivugwa mu
gika cya 3 zizaba zubahirijwe igihe ikigo kizerekana
ko :
a) imibare y`ibanga yo kurinda, ikarita cyangwa
ikindi gikoresho koranabuhanga bikoreshwa
mu gutanga uruhushya, byakoraga ku buryo
bwuzuye kuri uwo munsi, kandi
b) abayobozi cyangwa abakozi bashyizweho
n`ikigo batagira uburiganya cyangwa batari
indangare mu gukora iyohererezanya
koranabuhanga ry`amafaranga
Hakurikije ibigamijwe n`iyi ngingo, amakosa mu
imenyesha ry‟uko konti ihagaze hakubiyemo:
a) iyohererezanya koranabuhanga ry`amafaranga
rikosheje kuri konti y`umukiriya cyangwa biva
kuri konti ye
b) kongeraho cyangwa kudashyiraho
iyohererezanya koranabuhanga ry`amafaranga
bigira ingaruka kuri konti y`umukiriya mu
imenyekanisha ry‟uko konti ihagaze rya buri
gihe

articles.heading: Inshingano z`umukiriya Umukiriya ntagomba a) kugaragariza umuntu uwo ari wese ku buryo butaziguye cyangwa buziguye imibare
articles.text:
y`ibanga yo kurinda y`ikarita ye cyangwa
ikindi gikoresho koranabuhanga gikoreshwa
mw`iyohererezanya koranabuhanga
ry`amafaranga cyangwa uruhushya
koranabuhanga cyangwa ;
b) kudashobora kubika neza imibare y`ibanga
yo kwirinda cyangwa amabanga
y`ibikoresho koranabuhanga.
Banki cyangwa ikindi kigo gitanga serivisi zo
kwishyurana ntiyirengera ingaruka iyo bigaragaye
ko umukiriya yananiwe kuzuza inshingano zavuzwe
mu gika cya 1
Umukiriya ntiyirengera igihombo kizaturuka ku
ihererekanya ritemewe rikozwe nyuma y`uko
amenyesha banki ko ikarita ye yabuze,
yakoreshejwe nabi, cyangwa yibwe cyangwa ko
imibare y`ibanga yo kurinda cyangwa ibindi
bikoresho koranabuhanga bitanga uruhushya
koranabuhanga byakoreshejwe n`abatabyemerewe

articles.heading: Gutinda kumenyesha Iyo umukiriya yagize uruhare mu gihombo gituruka mu ihererekanya ritemewe bitewe no gutinda
articles.text:
kumenyesha ibura, inyerezwa, cyangwa ubujura
bw`ikarita cyangwa undi wese wamenya imibare
y`ibanga yo kwirinda y`ikarita, umukiriya yirengera
igihombo cyabaye uretse iyo
a) igice cy`igihombo cyabaye umunsi umwe
urenga ku gihe ntarengwa ku ihererekanya
rya buri munsi rikorerwa ku ikarita
cyangwa kuri konti; cyangwa
b) Igice cy`igihombo cyabaye kikaba kirenga
amafaranga ari konti ye

articles.heading: Igihe umukiriya atirengera ingaruka Umukiriya ntazirengera igihombo niba
articles.text:
a) Kitamuhama cyangwa atarakigizemo
uruhare ;
b) Byaratewe n`uburiganya cyangwa
uburangare kw`abayoboziabakozi cyangwa
abakozi bashyizweho.
i. N`ikigo
ii. Ibigo by`ubucuruzi cyangwa ibindi bigo
bikora imirimo y‟imiyoboro
koranabuhangacyangwa
iii. Abacuruzi bafite isano n‟ikoreshwa
ry‟ikarita cyangwa ubundi buryo
bw‟itumanaho
c) Baha umukiriya ibintu hakoreshejwe ikarita
itari y‟impimbano cyangwa y‟inyiganano,
ikosheje, yarengeje igihe cyangwa,
d) bikaba mbere y`uko umukiriya yakira
ikarita ye cyangwa imibare y`ibanga yo
kuyirinda.
Iyo habayeho ukutumvikana kujyanye n`ikarita
y`umukiriya, bifatwa ko umukiriya atabonye ikarita
ye, keretse ikigo kigaragaje ibinyuranye n`ibi.
UMUTWE WA IV : AMABWIRIZA
NGENDERWAHO

articles.heading: Amabwiriza ngenderwaho Banki cyangwa ikindi kigo gitanga serivisi bitanga uburyo ubwo aribwo bwose bw`iyohererezanya
articles.text:
koranabuhanga bigomba kugira amabwiriza
ngenderwaho ajyanye no gukora iryo yohererezanya
koranabuhanga akaba kandi agomba kumenyeshwa
Banki Nkuru.
Amabwiriza aigomba kuba yanditswe mu
Kinyarwanda, no muri rumwe muri izi ndimi
Igifaransa cyangwa Icyongereza, mu buryo
bugaragara neza, busomeka bwumvikana kandi
bworoshye gukoreshwa.
ikigo kigomba kumenyesha umukiriya amabwiriza
ngenderwaho mbere cyangwa mu gihe iyoherereza
koranabuhanga ry`amafaranga riri kuba.
Amabwiriza ngenderwaho mu gukora
iyohererezanya koranabuhanga harimo:
a) ibyo umukiriya yakwirengera mu
iyohererezanya koranabuhanga ry`amafaranga
ritemewe n`inshingano zo kumenyesha ikigo
ako kanya ibura, inyerezwa, iyibwa cyangwa
gukoresha bitemewe imibare y`ibanga cyangwa
ikarita ;
b) Nimero za telefoni na aderesi z`urwego
rw‟ikigo rushinzwe iyohererezanya
koranabuhanga ry`amafaranga akaba arirwo
rwohererezwa imenyeshwa mu gihe umukiriya
azi ko iyohererezanya koranabuhanga ritemewe
ryabaye cyangwa rishobora gukorwa ;
c) uburenganzira bw`umukiriya bwo guhagarika
iyishyurwa ry`amafaranga mu ihererekanya
koranabuhanga ry`amafaranga ryemewe mbere
y`igihe n`amabwiriza ngenderwaho n`uburyo
bwo gukora icyo gikorwa cyo guhagarika
inyandiko isaba kwishyura ;
d) amakuru ajyanye no gutanga ikirego, iperereza
n`uburyo go gukemura impaka ; n‟
e) Uburenganzira bw`umukiriya bwo guhabwa
inyandiko zijyanye n`iyohererezanya
koranabuhanga ry`amafaranga.
Amabwiriza y`umukiriya yo guhagarika kwishyura
iyohererezanya koranabuhanga ry`amafaranga
ryemewe mbere y`igihe byavuzwe mu gika cya (4)
(c) yubahirizwa ako kanya keretse umukiriya na
banki cyangwa ikindi kigo gitanga servisi zo
kwishyurana bumvikanye ukundi nk‟uko itariki
cyangwa isaha byagenwa mbere.
Hitawe ku kigamijwe n`iyi ngingo, « iyohererezanya
koranabuhanga ry`amafaranga ryemewe mbere
y`igihe » bisobanura ubwumvikane hagati
y`umukiriya n`ikigo gifite ububasha hatangwa
uruhushya rwo
a) Kwishyura undi muntuamafaranga ari kuri
konti y`umukiriya cyangwa
b) kwohereza amafaranga ava kuri konti
y`umukiriya ajyanwa kuri konti yindi
y`umukiriya ziri mu kigo kimwe cyangwa mu
kindi kigo

articles.heading: Ukuboneka kw`amabwiriza ngenderwaho Banki cyangwa ikindi kigo gitanga serivisi zo kwishyurana gishyira ahagaragara inyandiko
articles.text:
z`amabwiriza ngenderwaho mu Kinyarwanda no
muri rumwe muri izi ndimi Igifaransa cyangwa
icyongereza ku mashami yayo atanga serivisi
z`iyohererezanya koranabuhanga.

articles.heading: Impinduka ku mabwiriza ngenderwaho Banki cyangwa ikindi kigo gitanga serivisi zo kwishyurana bishobora guhindura amabwiriza
articles.text:
ngenderwaho mu ihererekanya koranabuhanga ry`
amafaranga ajyanye no
a) Gushyiraho cyangwa kongera amafaranga
yo kwishyura ibikorwa binyuranye
b) ukongera ibyo umukiriya yakwirengera ku
bihombo; cyangwa
c) Gushyiraho ihererekanya ntarengwa ku
ikoreshwa ry`ikarita
Igihe izo mpinduka zikorwa zigomba kumenyeshwa
Banki Nkuru y`u Rwanda, kandi banki cyangwa
ikindi kigo gitanga serivisi zo kwishyurana igomba
kubanza kubimenyesha umukiriya mu nyandiko

articles.heading: Imenyesha ku zindi mpinduka Banki cyangwa ikindi kigo gitanga serivisi zo kwishyurana gishobora kumenyesha umukiriya ku
articles.text:
mpinduka izo ari zo arizo zose zijyanye n`ingingo
ngenderwaho binyuze mu :
a) Imenyesha rya buri gihe rijyanye n`uko
konti ihagaze;
b) imenyesha ku cyuma koranabuhanga cyo
kubikuza (ATM), POS cyangwa ikindi
cyuma koranabuhanga
c) imenyesha ku mashami yayo ;cyangwa
d) ubundi buryo bwose bufatwa ko bukwiye
Igihe imenyesha ryatanzwe bijyanye n`igika cya
mbere (b), (c) cyangwa (d) kandi umukiriya atahise
abimenyeshwa, ikigo kigomba guhita kimenyesha
umukiriya mu buryo bwanditse.
Hatirengagijwe ibivugwa mu gika cya 1,
kumenyesha mbere ntibikenewe gutangwa igihe
impinduka no guhita basubizaho cyangwa bitewe no
kubungabunga umutekano w` ihererekanya
koranabuhanga ry` amafaranga, w‟uburyo bw`
iyohererezanya koranabuhanga ry` amafaranga,
cyangwa kuri konti y`umukiriya.
UMUTWE WA V : IPEREREZA N`UBURYO
BWO GUKEMURA IMPAKA

articles.heading: Ibibazo n`iperereza Banki cyangwa ikindi kigo gitanga serivisi zo kwishyurana a) ishyiraho uburyo bwo kuyijyezaho ibibazo
articles.text:
by`abakiriya bavugwa n`aya mabwiriza ;
b) Ishyiraho uburyo bukwiye bwo gukora
iperereza no gucyemura ikibazo cyose
cyatanzwe n`umukiriya, kandi ;
c) izamenyesha mu mabwiriza ngenderwaho
uburyo n‟imitangire y‟imitangire
y‟ikibazo.
Umukiriya asabwa guha ikigo amakuru yose
ajyanye n`ikibazo cye uretse ijambo rye ry`ibanga.
Ikigo kigomba guhita gikemura vuba ibyo bibazo
bijyanye no gusaba kurenganurwa.
Icyemezo cy`ikigo kijyanye n`ubwo busabe bwo
kurenganurwa kigomba gushingira ku bimenyetso
byose byatanzwe kandi ntibishingire ku myanzuro
idafite gihamya.
Ikigo kigomba kwemeza iyakira ry`ubusabe bwo
kurenganurwa mu minsi 5 uhereye ku itariki ubwo
busabe bwatangiwe, kandi kikaba gifite iminsi 15
ntarengwa yo gukemura ibyo bibazo.
Ikigo kigomba guhita kimenyesha umukiriya
ibyavuye mw`iperereza, n`impamvu zagendeweho
mu gukora iperereza
Iyo ugukemura ibibazo bidakozwe mu gihe
cyavuzwe, ikigo kigomba kubijyeza kuri Banki
Nkuru hamwe n`ibisobanuro

articles.heading: Konti yongereweho cyangwa yagabanyijweho mu buryo butari bwo Igihe ibivuye mu iperereza ry`ubusabe bwo
articles.text:
kurenganurwa habonetse ko konti y`umukiriya
yongereweho cyangwa yagabanyijweho amafaranga
mu buryo butari bwo, ikigo
a) gisubiranya konti y`umukiriya harimo
inyungu n`amafaranga yishyurwa ku bikorwa
runaka yakorewe
b) kumenyesha umukiriya mu nyandiko
ibyakemuwe kuri konti ye

articles.heading: Ibigo bitanga amakuru Igihe ikigo kizi ko umukiriya yirengera igihombo gituruka kw`ibura iryo ariryo ryose, inyerezwa,
articles.text:
iyibwa cyangwa ugukoreshwa bitemewe kw`ikarita
cyangwa kwica imibare y`ibanga yo kurinda
a) ikigo giha umukiriya inyandiko cyangwa
ibindi byemeza ibyavuye mu iperereza,
harimo avanywe ku ikusanyirizo ku
makuru y‟ihererekanya ;
b) ikigo kigomba kwifashisha ikusanyirizo ku
birebana n‟uburyo bw‟iyohererezanya
koranabuhanga ry‟amafaranga herekanwa
niba hari uburyo, urusobe cyangwa
igikoresho bitakoraga neza igihe
ihererekana ryakorwaga, kikamenyesha
kandi umukiriya ibivuye mu kirego cye.
Ikigo ntigisabwa gutanga amakuru ayo ariyo yose
ajyanye mu buryo butaziguye cyangwa afite
ingaruka ku mutekano w`ikigo cyangwa ku buryo
bw`imikorereyacyo y‟uburyo bwo iyohererezanya
korana buhanga ry‟amafaranga.

articles.heading: Amakuru ku burenganzira bwo kujurira Ibirebana no gutanga ikirego bigomba kugira amakuru arebana
articles.text:
a) uburenganzira bw`umukiriya ku kujuririra
ubuyobozi bukuru bwa banki cyangwa ikindi
kigo gitanga serivisi zo kwishyurana, igisubizo
yahawe ku kirego cye ;;
b) N`uburenganzira bw`umukiriya bwo
kumenyesha ikiregocye Banki Nkuru y`u
Rwanda cyangwa urundi rwego rubyemererwa
na Banki Nkuru y`u Rwanda, iyo atanyuzwe
n`ibyavuye mu busabe bwe
Ikigo kigomba guha umukiriya amakuru yose
yavuzwe mu gika cya 1

articles.heading: Iyandikwa ry‟ibibazo Ikigo kigomba kubika inyandiko z‟ibirego n`iz‟ibisubizo byabyokuburyo ibijyanye nabyo
articles.text:
byose, inshuro n`uko byakemuwe byahabwa Banki
Nkuru y`u Rwanda cyangwa urundi rwego
rubyemerewe na Banki Nkuru y`u Rwanda mu gihe
bikenewe

articles.heading: Ibimenyetso bigenewe ubugenzuzi Ikigo kigomba kureba niba iyohererezanya koranabuhanga ry`amafaranga ryacyo ritanga
articles.text:
inyandiko zihagije kugirango haboneke kandi
hagenzurwe ihererekanya, hanarebwe aho amakosa
yaturutse, agaragazwe kandi akosorwe
UMUTWE WA VI : INGINGO ZINYURANYE

articles.heading: Ibanga Ikigo kigomba kureba ko amakuru yose arebana n`iyohererezanya koranabuhanga ry`amafaranga
articles.text:
y`umukiriya atabwirwa uwo ariwe wese keretse
bitangiwe uburenganzira n`amabwiriza ya Banki
Nkuru y`u Rwanda.
Nta wundi muntu utari umuyobozi cyangwa
umukozi washyizweho n`ikigo gifite konti cyangwa
umukiriya, ufite uburenganzira bwo kugera ku
makuru arebana n`iyohererezanya koranabuhanga
ry`amafaranga, ibikorwa cyangwa konti
y`umukiriya abinyujije ku cyuma koranabuhanga.
Nta cyuma koranabuhanga kigomba kugira
ubushobozi bwo gutanga amakuru ayo ariyo yose
arebana n`iyohererezanya koranabuhanga
ry`amafaranga, ibikorwa cyangwa konti
y`umukiriya uretse :
a) iyohererezanya koranabuhanga
ry`amafaranga ryarakozwe n`umuyobozi
ubyemerewe cyangwa umukozi
washyizweho n`ikigo; cyangwa
b) Ubusabe bw`amakuru bwarabanjirijwe
n`ukwinjizwa mu cyuma koranabuhanga
kw`imibare y`ibanga cyangwa ikarita
y`umukiriya idakosheje.
Ikigo ntikizatanga amakuru ayo ariyo yose arebana
n` iyohererezanya koranabuhanga ry`amafaranga,
ibikorwa cyangwa konti y`umukiriya keretse
amakuru atanzwe :
a) Hashingiwe ku inshingano zigenwa
n`amategeko cyangwa
b) mu bwumvikane bw`umukiriya.
Amabwiriza agenga ikoreshwa rya konti ya buri
wese azakurikizwa kw`iyohererezanya
koranabuhanga ry`amafaranga mu bijyanye no guha
amakuru undi atagenewe.

articles.heading: Ikurwaho ry`uburenganzira no kurengera umukiriya mu buryo bukomeye Nta masezerano yanditse hagati y`umukiriya na
articles.text:
banki cyangwa ikindi kigo gitanga serivisi zo
kwishyurana ashobora kugira ibintu bikuraho
uburenganzira cyangwa bihungabanya
ibyashyizweho n`aya mabwiriza
Nta kintu na kimwe muri aya mabwiriza kizabuza
ubwumvikane bwose buha umukiriya uburenganzira
burambuye, gukemurirwa ibibazocyangwa
ukumurengera kurushaho kurenga ibiri muri aya
mabwiriza.

articles.heading: Uburyo bwihariye cyangwa gusonerwa Hagendewe ku mahame n‟amabwiriza agenga ugutanga serivisi zo kwishyurana, Banki Nkuru y`u
articles.text:
Rwanda ishobora gushyiriraho inzego zimwe za
servisi zo kwishyurana cyangwa inyandiko zo
kwishyurana uburyo bwihariye cyangwa
ukudakuriza, hagendewe ku miterere, ku kiguzi
cyangwa ku kamaro k‟ingamba zo kurengera
ababikoresha.
